# KDE Plasma System Tray Manual Order

> Tested implementation of persistent KDE Plasma system tray icon ordering,
> direct drag-and-drop in the panel and hidden popup, accessible configuration,
> safe user-local packaging, tests, and upstream patches.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/e-kala/kde-plasma-systray-order

Primary documents:

- AI implementation contract: ./AI_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md
- English overview: ./README.md
- Spanish overview: ./README.es.md
- Architecture: ./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Installation and rollback: ./docs/INSTALL.md
- Test evidence and checklist: ./docs/TESTING.md
- KDE upstream route: ./docs/UPSTREAM.md
- Ready-to-submit KDE MR description: ./docs/KDE_MR_DESCRIPTION.md
- Maintainer coordination message: ./docs/MAINTAINER_MESSAGE.md

Reusable artifacts:

- Complete Plasma 6.7.5 patch series: ./patches/v6.7.5/
- Direct-drag extension for KDE MR 6958: ./patches/upstream-mr6958/
- Reproducible scripts: ./scripts/

Key rule: reuse the existing patch series and documented invariants; do not
recode the feature from scratch unless the target Plasma version proves an
incompatibility through compilation or tests.
